correctness.rationale: For nonzero symmetric bilinear B on a two-space V over any field, radical m=V+kz of A=k1+V+kz has m²=kz and m³=0. The weight-minus-one RB identity with P²=P is equivalent to image and kernel each closed under products. Any subalgebra containing an element with nonzero scalar residue contains 1 by the invertible element’s minimal polynomial; hence exactly one summand is unital. Radical subalgebras admit nontrivial complementary line-plane pairs only if the line lifts an isotropic projective direction and the plane contains kz with distinct projected direction. For Fq each isotropic direction gives q lift lines and q complementary planes, yielding N=h_B q²; two orientations and complementary ranks give polynomial 1+(1+N)T+2NT²+(1+N)T³+T⁴. Characteristic-two alternating/nonalternating and odd split/anisotropic/rank-one isotropy are handled explicitly. Independent exhaustive direct 2^16 linear-map checks over F2 for three distinct forms reproduced rank distributions.

originality.rationale: PASS, qualified. Idempotent RB operators as subalgebra projections are a known general equivalence (Jian 2013 and prior). The submitted novelty is not that equivalence: it is the complete all-field radical splitting criterion and finite-field rank distribution sensitive to projective isotropy, including degenerate forms and char two. The closest previously indexed finite local quadratic-algebra result instead counts averaging projections, which obey different image/kernel identities; spin-factor and square-zero radical results have different algebra objects or weights. No exact pre-existing isotropic RB rank polynomial was found.
residual_risks: A general classification of complementary subalgebras in short Gorenstein local rings may imply the rank formula under alternate terminology.
Not all relevant general RB monographs or original primary papers were available in full text.
F2 checks are finite and do not certify arbitrary fields, especially imperfect characteristic-two fields.
